shared_elements: animals rendered in low relief in profile
quadruped with head/jaws shown in side view
anthropomorphic figure with arms bent toward the body
horizontal band of repeated pattern (zigzag/net) crossing the surface
justification: Both surfaces combine a human-like figure with animals carved in raised, flat-bodied relief, and both include profile quadrupeds with heads/jaws turned to the side and serpentine forms, which is a real if broad correspondence in subject and carving convention. The compositions differ strongly, however: A is a single dominant, nearly free-standing frontal human figure with arms folded over the abdomen and animals symmetrically flanking it, whereas B is a multi-register assemblage of varied birds, quadrupeds, snake and geometric bands stacked one above another with no central dominant figure.
